help.title: Marketing Pipeline Guide
help.subtitle: Impulso turns a topic into scheduled posts in four steps. Here's how the pipeline works.
help.generate_desc: Describe a topic or theme and Impulso writes a batch of tweet angles for your account.
generate_details: Enter a topic, trend, or idea you want to post about
Choose a tone: Professional, Casual, Witty, Authoritative, Inspirational, or Custom
Select a language and number of drafts to generate
AI produces multiple tweet variations you can review
help.curate_desc: Review drafts, approve the ones you like, add design briefs, and generate images.
curate_details: Drag cards across four stages: Draft → Curated → Designed → Image ready
Approve drafts to move them to the Curated column
Add a visual brief describing the image you want
Generate images with AI (GPT Image, Gemini Flash, or DALL·E 3)
Regenerate images with feedback until they look right
help.schedule_desc: Drag ready posts onto your weekly calendar to plan when each tweet goes out.
schedule_details: Ready posts appear in the tray on the left
Drag them onto any day of the week
Set the exact time for each post
Preview how the post will look on X before publishing
help.publish_desc: Impulso publishes your scheduled tweets automatically via your connected X account.
publish_details: Connect each X account independently in Settings → X accounts
Scheduled posts are published automatically at the set time
Track post status: Scheduled → Publishing → Posted
View engagement after a post goes live
help.tip_brand_kit: Upload your logo, set brand colors, and add style notes in Settings → Brand kit. AI-generated images will follow your brand guidelines.
help.tip_account_brief: Write a short brief for each X account in Settings → Account brief. This helps the AI understand your voice and audience.
help.tip_multiple_accounts: Add as many X accounts as you need. Each keeps its own pipeline, schedule, and image styles.
help.tip_image_styles: Create reusable image style templates per account so your visuals stay consistent across posts.
